newsitem.title: JAPAN: Kobe rubber futures lower in after-hours session.
newsitem.headline: Kobe rubber futures lower in after-hours session.

text.p: Kobe rubber futures were lower in the after-hours session on Friday, as sell orders continued to push down the market, traders said.
Prices were 0.2 to 0.5 yen per kg lower than the day's close. Benchmark March was down 0.2 yen at 136.0 yen.
During the day, prices gained as investors conducted technical buying. The yen's weaker sentiment against the dollar also encouraged investors to buy, the traders said.
Traders said rubber stocks would be a near-term market factor. "We're watching for when local rubber stocks will start falling," a brokerage house trader said.
